title: Todos and task tracking

body.text: For multi-step work, Claude Code creates a
todo list so you can see the steps and how far along it is
— the list updates live while it works: pending → in progress → completed, so you always see progress.

example: "A big task shows: ✓ create the API endpoint / ⏳ add the UI page / ○ write tests / ○ update docs"

title: Use the todo to control scope

body.text: The todo list is a promise of what it'll do —
see the list and you can speak up immediately if something's missing or extra
, like 'add an item: also test on mobile' or 'skip the last item, it's out of scope'.

example: "You see the todo has no migration of old data → say 'don't forget to migrate the existing user data' before it starts"

question: What is the todo list in Claude Code for?

options.text: Seeing the steps and progress of multi-step work

question: You see the todo list is missing an important step. What should you do?

options.text: Speak up immediately to add that step
Wait until it's done, then mention it
Don't say anything, it'll figure it out

question: How does the todo help with multi-step work?

options.text: Breaks work into steps and stays on track
